description: Add and/or remove tags on a ticket without touching anything else. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/update_tags/.

add.description: Tags to add, as a comma-separated string.

remove.description: Tags to remove, as a comma-separated string.

staff_id.description: The agent making the change (shown in the ticket history) id.

ticket_number.description: The ticket NUMBER (the `id` field, e.g. 3 for #DC00000003) — not the prefixed display id.

name: happyfox_update_ticket_tags
title: Add or remove ticket tags
